identitySignals: Aspire Golden State College Preparatory Academy is a public charter school for grades 6-12 in Oakland, CA, within the Oakland Unified School District (GreatSchools), matching the agenda's Measures N and H college and career readiness funding.

Aspire Public Schools' own site has a post describing the school (GSP) taking part in charter renewal hearings with Oakland Unified School District, and lists a Bay Area office at 1009 66th Avenue, Oakland, the school's street address.
ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer lists Aspire Public Schools, Oakland, CA, as a 501(c)(3) that operates K-12 schools (EIN 94-3311088); its website and headquarters are in Oakland.
research.notes: The agenda vendor is a charter school; the profile describes its operator, Aspire Public Schools, the nonprofit that holds the EIN (reviewer should confirm the school is not a separate legal entity). Email omitted: Aspire's home page shows communications@aspirepublicschools.org while its contact page shows info@aspirepublicschools.org. CA Secretary of State number and SAM UEI not checked. The school's charter renewal was denied by OUSD and the county and was being appealed to the State Board (EdSource, 2026).

profile.summary: Aspire Golden State College Preparatory Academy is a public charter school in Oakland, California, serving students in grades 6 through 12. It is part of Aspire Public Schools, a nonprofit that operates public charter schools in California and focuses on preparing students for college.

review.notes: GreatSchools lists Aspire Golden State College Preparatory Academy as an Oakland Unified-area charter (grades 6-12) operated by Aspire Public Schools, and the Aspire site names the school as one of its Bay Area schools. ProPublica confirms the 501(c)(3), EIN 94-3311088, Oakland, and the Aspire contact page confirms the main office address, phone and website; the summary is supported and neutral.
